Native captures receive-wall and monotonic observation time before disk work, then binds it only to the successful exact Spool ACK sequence/track/append/chunk/end/payload hash. Require the hinted end inside that chunk's range or at most16bytes before it (bounded EBML header recognition), <=32MiB first-unit extent and <=15seconds from begin. Duplicate ACK cannot replace it. Write one closed <=4KiB create_new synced youtube-raw-anchor.json; absence or failed write never creates a synthetic anchor. Keep the raw proof/journal v1 unchanged in this batch.
firstReceiptAndChat.nativeValidation: During the existing held recovery receipt pass, match the sidecar's full identity and exact receipt facts; retain the sidecar handle with the source evidence. Browser timestamps, clock values, payload signatures and mere file existence are not accepted. Invalid/missing anchor affects timing/chat quality, not permission to publish independently verified video. The first unit need not be retained by later selection; its validated affine relation can still locate the selected common origin.

Invalid/reset/overflow relation yields missing-anchor, never clamping or a remux-time fallback.
